## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Pārāyanatthutigāthāniddesa* ("Exposition of Homage to the Way to the Beyond") is an early canonical commentary preserved as the twenty-first section of the *Cūḷaniddesa* (Cnd 21) within the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The work provides word-by-word glosses and doctrinal analysis of the verses of homage connected with the *Pārāyanavagga* (*Pārāyanatthutigāthā*, Snp 5.18; also cataloged as Cnd 3) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral indexes two modern translations across two languages [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral records passage-level parallels to the text in the *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (*Mahāniddesa* 16) and the *Ānāpānassatikathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.3) [SuttaCentral]. In algorithmic text-reuse analysis, DharmaNexus identifies 1,357 matching passages shared with 96 other Pali texts, reflecting the highly standardized exegetical phraseology shared across the Niddesa literature [DharmaNexus]. Its primary Pali reuse partners include the companion *Pārāyanānugītigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 22), the *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 16, confirming SuttaCentral's parallel), the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), and the root verses in the *Pārāyanatthutigāthā* (Snp 5.18 and Cnd 3), alongside substantial verbal overlap with commentaries such as the *Khuddakapāṭha-aṭṭhakathā* and *Itivuttaka-aṭṭhakathā* [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns several segments with non-Pali works, producing matches with the Tibetan translation of the *Udānavargavivaraṇa* (D4100-2) and the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99) [DharmaNexus].
